name: Aberrant-Born Sorcery
body:
You have learned to quickly adapt your anatomy to survive dangerous situations.

Prerequisite: Aberrant bloodline sorcerer or aberration creature type

Benefit: You gain a +1 bonus to Will Saves. A number of times per day equal to 1 + your Charisma modifier you can use your Will save bonus in place of your Fortitude or Reflex bonus by changing the nature of your aberrant anatomy.
